name: udm
description: 无人物流调度管理软件 · 本地优先桌面应用

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace renderer
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:shared && npm run build:desktop && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace renderer" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run start --workspace desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace renderer
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace desktop && node desktop/dist/cli/db.js migrate
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace desktop && node desktop/dist/cli/db.js seed
scripts.db:reset: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace desktop && node desktop/dist/cli/db.js reset
